occupation: Workers Employed in Shops & Catering Establishments
Workers Engaged in Bricks and Tiles Manufacturing
Workers Engaged in Distribution of Liquid Petroleum Gas Cylinder
other_conditions: Must be a citizen of India.
Must be a resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry.
Must be an unorganized worker belonging to the listed occupations.
Must be enrolled with the Puducherry Unorganised Labourers' Welfare Society.
Must be between 18 and 59 years of age.
Must pay an annual subscription of ₹100.
Must pay a registration fee of ₹25.
benefits_summary: Cash gift of ₹500 transferred via Direct Benefit Transfer to the worker during Diwali.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attest, if required)
